tokyo-okutama-lake-forest-day.title: Tokyo · Okutama Lake and Forest Road Day
tokyo-okutama-lake-forest-day.slogan: A 178 km loop out of Tokyo west exit
tokyo-okutama-lake-forest-day.story: A clean westbound escape with water, forest shade and proper mountain rhythm. Out of Kokubunji and back again: 178 km, roughly 4 h in the saddle. It goes by way of Hanno, Okutama lake road and Akiruno. The climb of the day is Kazahari pass road. It tops out at 1,146 m.

scenicChapters.title: Hanno fuel gate → Okutama lake road
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 44 km. 430 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Okutama lake road → Kazahari pass road
scenicChapters.narrative: First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding. The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 6.9%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter.

scenicChapters.title: Kazahari pass road → Akiruno food stop
scenicChapters.narrative: 46 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

tokyo-okutama-lake-forest-day.storyWas: A clean westbound escape with water, forest shade and proper mountain rhythm.
